milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the composter (at spawn-relative 5, 0, 3) and face toward it, confirming they can see it. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures they are close enough to visually identify it, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dried kelp block drops the block as an item which enters the player's inventory. The player needs to break the dried kelp block (at spawn-relative 8, 0, 6) and collect the drop. No tool is required to mine dried kelp blocks.
